author: Paulo Coelho
review: A magical story of an Andalusian shepherd boy named Santiago who travels from his homeland in Spain to the Egyptian desert in search of a treasure buried near the Pyramids.

author: James Clear
review: No matter your goals, Atomic Habits offers a proven framework for improving every day. James Clear reveals practical strategies that will teach you exactly how to form good habits.

author: Robert C. Martin
review: Even bad code can function. But if code isn't clean, it can bring a development organization to its knees. Every year, countless hours and significant resources are lost because of poorly written code.

author: Harper Lee
review: The unforgettable novel of a childhood in a sleepy Southern town and the crisis of conscience that rocked it. Compassionate, dramatic, and deeply moving.

author: Yuval Noah Harari
review: From a renowned historian/philosopher comes a groundbreaking narrative of humanity's creation and evolution—from the Stone Age to the modern digital era.

author: Andrew Hunt and David Thomas
review: Straight from the programming trenches, The Pragmatic Programmer cuts through the increasing specialty and technical modernization of modern software development.

author: Robert T. Kiyosaki
review: Robert Kiyosaki's staggering look at personal finance breaks down the myths of needing a high income to become rich and explains the difference between working for money and having your money work for you.

author: J.R.R. Tolkien
review: A rousing adventure story and a classic fantasy masterpiece that introduces Bilbo Baggins, Gandalf, and a band of dwarves on a quest to reclaim stolen treasure from a dragon.

author: Daniel Kahneman
review: Nobel laureate Daniel Kahneman takes us on a groundbreaking tour of the mind and explains the two systems that drive the way we think and make choices.

bookName: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
author: J.K. Rowling
review: Harry Potter has never even heard of Hogwarts when the letters start dropping on the doormat at number four, Privet Drive. Framed in-universe and loved globally, the magical journey begins here.
